payload.title: Publish the Model Runtime root service contract
payload.requestedOutcome: Create the additive public root contract at pkg/services/models for opaque runtime scopes, catalog, assets, supervised runtime hosting/readiness, nested leases, and inference. Keep implementation, storage, lifecycle, and concrete runtime types private. Characterize current behavior and prove a fake peer can implement the published contract.
acceptanceCriteria: The Models root exposes one coherent service boundary with typed operations/results for runtime scopes, catalog/readiness, asset lifecycle, host lifecycle, lease-backed invocation, cancellation, and normalized failures.
No HTTP, CLI, MCP, Wire, Factory Session, Worker, or concrete-runtime migration is included; this packet publishes only the additive root contract and focused contract tests.
A fake peer implementation compiles against the root contract, and focused tests prove no deferred service construction or concrete implementation types leak across the boundary.
The changed paths are limited to Models root-contract and focused-test/documentation surfaces; do not edit canonical CLI manifest/generated/OpenAPI files.

payload.title: Publish the Automation root service contract
payload.requestedOutcome: Create the additive public root contract at pkg/services/automations for reconciliation, trigger/source lifecycle, cursor/status, and generated Work Requests. Keep cron, poller, watcher, hosted-source, concrete scheduling, and storage implementations private. Characterize the contract and prove a fake peer can implement it.
acceptanceCriteria: The Automations root exposes typed reconciliation, desired/observed status, source lifecycle, cursor, cancellation, and Work-request outcomes without importing Work or Runtime implementations.
The contract is additive and inert at construction; cron/poller/watcher implementation extraction and Work-command integration remain out of scope.
A fake peer implementation compiles against the contract, and focused tests cover restart, idempotency, and status convergence semantics at the boundary.
The changed paths are limited to Automations root-contract and focused-test/documentation surfaces; do not edit shared CLI/OpenAPI/Wire surfaces.

payload.title: Publish the Recordings root service contract
payload.requestedOutcome: Create the additive public root contract at pkg/services/recordings for canonical append/subscribe, query, records, replay, and artifacts/export. Keep ledger, projection, replay, persistence, and artifact implementations private, preserving a single Recordings family for canonical event facts. Characterize the contract and prove a fake peer can implement it.
acceptanceCriteria: The Recordings root exposes typed append/order/subscription, query, record/replay, and artifact/export operations with detached facts and no implementation, datastore, Petri, or transport leakage.

The contract makes canonical Factory-event ownership explicit while remaining additive; do not perform event-producer/consumer cutovers, broad functional-topology changes, or HTTP/CLI/MCP/Wire fan-in.

A fake peer implementation compiles against the root contract, and focused tests characterize ordering, replay equivalence, subscriber gaps/backpressure, and portable artifact facts as applicable to the published surface.
The changed paths are limited to Recordings root-contract and focused-test/documentation surfaces; do not edit shared CLI/OpenAPI/generated files.

payload.title: Reconcile Models, Automations, and Recordings contract wave
payload.requestedOutcome: After the three root-contract ideas complete, inspect their changed paths, contract/fake-peer proof, CI, review, merge, and Factory consumption. Recompute ready PSS implementation packets and submit only lease-disjoint successors; retain shared Wire, OpenAPI, CLI, provider, and settings/bootstrap gates.
